notes.title: New game released!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! If you enjoyed Serafina's Crown, you'll probably like our new comedy romance game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/787970/miraclr__Divine_Dating_Sim/]miraclr - Divine Dating Sim[/url], now released!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/787970/miraclr__Divine_Dating_Sim/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31856198/fbefcb61c1cd7a8f6a0d4be524951727623cfa79.png[/img][/url]

I hope you all enjoy the new game <3
- Jenny and Malcolm
